book.name: Yoan
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Yoan byex o

content: Yesu la Bouk ngandoung wei Xomek Laweeng o
Ka tine la veil eno Yesu la di ghavineeng eivek Galili, en embei se nox Yudia en Yudayeiw embei nyeis e mey.
Ekom gyeik ingwei xel Yudayeiw xe Bouk ngandoung wei Xomek Laweeng eno paviy,
om Yesu liyeiw neil wou e, “Wang na veil Galili me ghe na Yudia, en kandek wa xe xel betiyeing gyei lulvako wei wa being bong o.
Wangwei xelti embei xomaxoneing boulek bei e lei ngandoung on se mi wong xuk eivek xupekeing. Wangwei wa being bong lulti beimambei yon, ond wa talex xow wou xomaxoneing wei tembuing sapa nei.”
Embong emaxow liyeiw le, ekom xel se wongis e.
Nambei nyon Yesu neil wou xel, “A xe bouk se ghei lam, qe bouk dalus ne eno inye xam xe bouk nimza.
Xel xomaxoneing wei tembuing ne eno se teyei bei bo nol wou xam, qe xel mi wo nol wou ay en a mi neil kwa nilul wei xel mi wong o teyei.
Xam ghe na Bouk ngandoung on. Dom tyek a se zek me nana Bouk ngandoung tiyon, en nambei a xe bouk se ghei lam.”
Ka neil ambei nyon wou xel woy, dom toundei Galili.
Ka liyeiw la Bouk ngandoung veil, om moxo la is ambei nyon, se la yanyateiv, qe la xupekeing.
De eivek Bouk ngandoung eno teivateiv wei Yudayeiw toundei me di yei e teyei teyei me teling bei, “Tambiy tiwei yo inya?”
Eivek xel wei qekuma yon senghoing eno xel di ngoung lumama wouma me luk en moxo. Xel valu neil embei, “Moxo nimza.” De xel valu neil elox bei, “ Ma, tambiy on mi tyoxe xomaxoneing.”
Ekom xelti se neil lulti yeip yaing lek moxo en xel yaleeng en teivateiv wei Yudayeiw o.
Yesu teyoxe xel nanghei ingwei Bouk ngandoung nei
Eivek bouk senghoing wei Bouk ngandoung eno Yesu lek me la eivek tete lalei wei xomek vambuing o me di teyoxe moux alis vex.
De Yudayeiw etek me teling bei, “Tambiy nei qou lupeyei nei nambei nya moxo se wevek ti?”
Yesu lewexe, “A xe teyoxeing ne inye se a maxow xe. Qe inye lam wou tiwei wong a lam o.
Wangwei xelti beyal bei bong e teyei lek Anutu lalei ond tyek gyei bei teyoxeing wei a ne lam wou Anutu, o a di neil angya a maxow kwang.
Xelti embei neil qayeeng angya emaxow xe kwa ond inyon mi sanghoxe xow, ekom xelti embei bong xuk me sanghoxe tiwei wong e lam o lei, ond inyon tambiy wei zonghek o. De tyonyeing ma veil e.
Beip Mose se wong petieing wou xam? Ekom xam ti seng mi betiwou. Nambei nya xam a being nyeis a mey?”
Xel wei qekuma yon lewexe bei, Memo ti nale eivek wang. “Eti embei nyeis wang?”
Yesu neil wou xel, “A wong lulvako ti eno xam dalus ghe etek.
Mose wong kwa wei ghuweing ninavi yo, ekom inyon Mose venaxow se wong kwa yon qe inyon lam wou xe bundyeiw, om xam ghe mi ghuw yak ninavi lek bouk wei Sabat o.

Wangwei xam ambei mi ghuw yakyeis ninavi lek bouk wei Sabat o en kandek xam se pyalek Mose xe petieing, on nambei nya xam laleimim mi wo vanei wou ay en ingwei ambei bong tambiy ti bo nimzalek Sabat o?
Xam a tip pepyawexeing lul wei xam a being gwei nangya mamim o, de xam pepyawexe en sakwaing bombek.”
Xel pyalek ama bei Yesu yon eti?
En qes tiyon xomaxoneing valu wei Yerusalem nei teling, “Beip inyei tambiy tiwei xel embei nyeis e mey o?
Inye moxo di luk wou xel yanyateiv me xel di yei me ngo e ekom xelti se nale zeyi e, en beip xel gyovaxa woulek neing bei e Kilisi?
Ekom xey a woulek ingwei tambiy tine lam anghei yo, de gyeik ingwei Kilisi embei nam eno tyek xelti se boulek ingwei lam anghei yo.”

Woyom Yesu nanghei di teyoxe xel eivek tete lalei wei xomek vambuing o, me taxe bei, “Ee, xam ghe woulek ay, me xam ghe woulek ingwei a lam anghei yo? A se lam inye nangya a venaxow xe woueing nalei, qe tambiy tiwei wong a lam eno inye zonghek. De xam seng woulek e,
ekom a woulek e en nambei a lam anghei ingwei e toundei nei de moxo wong a lam.”
Gyeik ingwei Yesu neil tiyon eno xel di wong me yei en xel embei zeimaxoun moxo, ekom xelti se ax mema lek e en nambei moxo xe bouk se ghei lam.
Moux alis vex ngenong wei toundei eivek qekueing ama yon eno wongis Yesu. Xel neil embei, “Gyeik ingwei Kilisi embei nam eno tyek bong dee wei lulvako yo ngenong ghanaw tambiy tine?”

De xel Parisi ngo ingwei moux alis vex di ngoung wouma en lul wei e wong o. Woyom xel lumuki leitata yo me xel Parisi wong xel belimbo wei mi yeiteyei xomek vambuing eno la en xel embei na zeimaxoun e.
Yesu neil embei, “Tyek a toumendei bouk sepika is xam, dekakom nana wou tambiy tiwei wong a lam o.
Tyek xam ghe gwimexe ay, ekom tyek xam seng gweiwou ay, me ingwei a la toundei nei, eno xam seng teyei being nam.”
De Yudayeiw di neil wouma bei, “Tambiy tine tyek na inya me xe se ghei e? Tyek moxo na wou xel wei xey o, wei xel mindei lala eivek xel Grik senghoing o me teyoxe xel Grik?
Moxo neil tine en qes ambei nya gyeik ingwei e neil embei, ‘Tyek xam ghe gwimexe ay ekom tyek xam seng gweiwou ay,’ me ‘Ingwei a la toundei nei, eno tyek xam seng nam?’”
Lek bouk ngandoung tiwei yus o, eno Yesu nale me taxe bei, “Wangwei xelti kwa tip en memiing ond wong e lam wou ay me num.
Xelti embei bongis ay nambei Xoulek neil o, on tyek memiing veleivlei wei mapieing eno mendi na eivek e lalei me qapyex me na.”
Ekom neil en Laweeng wei xelti embei bongis e eno tyek na qou yo. De ela tyip bouk tine eno Laweeng seng ghei lam, en Yesu seng ghei wo lei ngandoung.
Xel ngo e xe qayeeng tiyon, eno xomaxoneing valu neil embei, “Neing ayang tambiy tiyon Poropet.”
De xel valu neil embei, “Moxo Kilisi.” De xel valu teling bei, “Nambei nya Kilisi tyek nam anghei Galili?
Beip xoulek se neil embei Kilisi tyek nam eivek Dawit neumambu me nam anghei Betelem, beyeeng wei Dawit mindei lek o?”
En nambei Yesu om xomaxoneing dembuma.
Xel valu embei zeimaxoun e, ekom xelti se ax mema lek moxo.
Yudayeiw xe gyovaxa se wongis Yesu
Se denlek en xel belimbo wei xomek vambuing o lox me la wou xel lumuki leitata yo me Parisiyeiw, xel teling wou xel, “Nambei nya xam seng qou e me ghe lam lalei?”
Xel belimbo neilteyei bei, “Xelti se mi neil qayeeng ambei tambiy tine.”
Xel Parisi neil wou xel bei, “Moxo tyoxe xam is ambei nyon?
Beip xam ghe wei bei xel gyovaxa me xel Parisi ti wongis e?
Ma! Ekom xel qendu tiyon se woulek lulti eivek petieing. Om tyek Anutu bong myaveweeng wou xel.”
Nikodimas, tambiy tiwei la wou Yesu takwei eno inyon ingwei xel o ti, om teling,
“Beip petieing wei xey o neil embei xey a bo qayeeng en xelti bandaing? Ma, myaxeeng eno xey a ngo e xe qayeeng me na ghei bei e wong vati?”
Xel neil elox bei, “Wang on Galili is? Wimexe e wo nimza eivek Anutu xe qapiya me wei, Poropet ti tyek se nam eivek Galili.”
Xel qou vex wei wo kwa pesiv o ti me la wou Yesu7:53-8:11 Xel wei lupeyei eno neil embei Yoan se byex, qe tambiy nge byex.
Woyom xel titi lox me la bend bend.
